text.tspan: CorrectionStatus ladder -- PENDING -> FORWARDED -> RESOLVED, with REJECTED the other terminal. Every mutation, plus the two admin reads, writes one guest_correction_audit_logs row through
GuestCorrectionAuditService.record(), which runs REQUIRES_NEW so the audit row survives a rolled-back request. GuestCorrectionAuditAction is exactly SUBMIT, VIEW, LIST, FORWARD, RESOLVE, REJECT,
GuestCorrectionAPI is @PreAuthorize(isAuthenticated()) at class level -- GUEST, EMPLOYEE and ADMIN may all submit, no correction:*
authority needed. Body is GuestCorrectionSubmitRequestDTO (mediaType, mediaCode, targetField, currentValue, suggestedValue, note).
Image / Text twin and returns MediaInfo(title, createdBy). An unknown or
The saved row snapshots mediaTitle and recordCreatedBy off the media record and guestUserId / guestUsername / guestDisplayName off the
caller. safe() trims and HtmlUtils.htmlEscape()s targetField, currentValue, suggestedValue and note -- mediaCode and the snapshotted mediaTitle
are stored exactly as they came in.
AdminGuestCorrectionAPI is hasRole(ADMIN) at class level plus hasAuthority(correction:read) on this
Sorted createdAt DESC then id DESC. includeRemoved defaults to false, so soft-deleted corrections stay out
of the queue but keep their audit trail.
hasAuthority(correction:update). AdminCorrectionForwardRequestDTO is an optional body carrying targetEmployeeId and forwardNote. Target =
An in-process call to UserWarningService, not an HTTP hop --
UserWarningAPI only serves the employee-facing GETs below. severity =
buildForwardMessage(correction, dto) -- media, field, current value,
suggested value, guest note, admin note.
forwardedBy, forwardedAt and forwardNote are stamped on the correction. The two miss cases are asymmetric: an explicit targetEmployeeId matching no user throws
IllegalAdminOperationException(EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND) -> 409 CONFLICT, but a recordCreatedBy username matching no user sends no warning at all and still moves the
status to FORWARDED -- nothing tells the admin the message went nowhere.

then createdAt DESC, so the new INFO
warning sits at the top of the employee
Acknowledging writes UserAuditAction.WARNING_ACKNOWLEDGED to user_audit_logs and touches nothing in guest_corrections. A repeat acknowledge is a no-op returning the same DTO, and a warning an
admin has since revoked answers 404 WARNING_NOT_FOUND rather than 409. The employee applies the actual fix through the ordinary media update endpoint, and the correction stays FORWARDED until an
adminResolve() refuses only a REJECTED row -- PENDING, FORWARDED and an already RESOLVED row
all fall through and re-stamp resolvedBy, resolvedAt and resolveNote from
Admin B acts on the same correction id, from a queue page loaded before

The 409 body is ApiErrorResponse(status 409, error CORRECTION_ALREADY_PROCESSED, category CONFLICT, hint This correction was already accepted or rejected -- refresh the list to see its current state).

The same guard blocks /resolve on a REJECTED row and /reject on a RESOLVED row. It is a status check, not a lock -- two writes that genuinely overlap trip the @Version column on GuestCorrection and answer 409
CONFLICT with error STALE_VERSION from ObjectOptimisticLockingFailureException.
